scope: Read-only isolated feasibility of inactive finite negative node requests.

method.outsideBoundary: Original modeled input clamped to its actual existing bound; all fixed canonical/floor/explicit values retained. A failure under this held boundary is conditional unless directConflictsWithOutsideExistingBounds proves a row impossible under every existing outside bound.
method.candidateZeroArms: All26 emitted affine arrays fixed by the24 single modeled node datums; no range widened.
method.negativeArmWindows: Only complete per-arm finite controls within their current local envelopes may vary; all fixed anchors remain exact.
method.matrixRows: Held full-source headroom/coupling and node equalities intersecting the finite component; exact held grade/triangle/comfort formulas, additionally checking fixed geometry rows physically.
